policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: This route's distinguishing feature is the upgrade path: 21 months of qualifying employment within 24 converts it to a Red-White-Red Card Plus with unlimited labour-market access. The salary standard is comparative rather than a figure — what comparable Austrian junior employees would receive.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as Singapore's MOM and the US ESTA pages already live.
not_extracted: THE POINTS TABLE where this route has one. Its criterion-to-score mapping does not survive normalization — rows flatten so criteria and scores become separate consecutive lines, and the association exists only in visual layout. Thresholds stated in prose are quoted; individual scores are not.

requirements.label: Paid the customary salary of comparable Austrian graduates
requirements.description: A comparative standard, not a fixed amount, so no figure can age out of date — but also nothing an applicant can check without knowing the local market.
requirements.source_excerpt: you get paid the locally customary gross minimum salary which comparable austrian graduates (junior employees) would receive and

requirements.label: 21 of the preceding 24 months' qualifying employment upgrades to unlimited access
requirements.description: The upgrade is the point of this route. Both numbers matter: 21 months of employment inside a 24-month window.
requirements.source_excerpt: you may apply for a red-white-red card plus with unlimited labour market access if you were employed in accordance with the eligibility criteria for at least 21 months during the preceding 24 months.
